name: 130-endpoint-clear-of-a-pour-fill-region
why: Same square. The cap centre is at x=20.3, which is 0.300mm outside the x=20 edge, and the 0.4mm run's cap radius is 0.200mm — so the copper stops 0.100mm short of the plane. That is 100x the 0.001mm coincidence tolerance, so no float noise can close it.
